name: Heroicons Animated
summary: MIT animated Heroicons for React via Motion — 316 free icons, shadcn registry or npm.
gaps: Narrow icon micro-interaction library (316 icons) — not a full UI kit.
Pilot includes 12 of 316 free registry icons.
No per-icon docs URLs; all iframe demos point at the interactive homepage catalog.
Also publishes Vue/Svelte packages — this ingest is React-primary only.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Heart Icon

demo.peerNotes: MIT animated Heroicons (Motion). Site hosts interactive hover demos for all icons. Install per-icon via shadcn registry or npm `@heroicons-animated/react`.

copyPrompt.text: Use heroicons-animated free MIT React icon `HeartIcon` (slug `heart`) from https://www.heroicons-animated.com. Install with `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @heroicons-animated/heart` or `pnpm add @heroicons-animated/react motion`. Import from `@heroicons-animated/react`. Peer: motion. Home: https://www.heroicons-animated.com. Registry: https://www.heroicons-animated.com/r/registry.json. Repo: https://github.com/Aniket-508/heroicons-animated. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aniket-508/heroicons-animated/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Aniket Pawar). Pricing free.
